editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Praxis Audiology Examination with 120 selected-response questions across 5 domains in a duration of 120 minutes.
editorial.overview: The Praxis Audiology Examination, certified by ETS, measures the knowledge, clinical judgment, and analytical capabilities required for independent practice as a professional audiologist. The exam contains exactly 120 selected-response questions and is delivered on a computer over a structured duration of 120 minutes, evaluating core competencies across five distinct content domains.
editorial.who_should_take: Examinees who are currently enrolled in or have successfully completed a doctoral degree program preparing them for professional practice in audiology should take this exam. It serves as an important credentialing requirement for ASHA certification and state licensure.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official study guide in its entirety and build a personalized study schedule based on your available preparation time before test day. Practice with representative sample questions, carefully examine specific topic objectives, and utilize all available resource materials to solidify your understanding of core clinical concepts.

domain_guidance.summary: This core domain focuses extensively on the underlying physics of sound, the detailed anatomy and physiology of the auditory and vestibular systems, associated pathophysiology, and complex psychometric principles required for accurate clinical evaluation.

This domain covers standard clinical education strategies, detailed exposure assessment techniques, risk mitigation protocols, standardized screening procedures, and continuous program performance monitoring designed specifically for hearing and balance disorders.

This assessment domain addresses thorough clinical preparation, advanced behavioral and physiologic audiological evaluations, focused vestibular assessments, and the systematic clinical integration of diagnostic results for diverse patient populations.

This intervention domain covers systematic treatment planning, advanced device selection, detailed device verification procedures, wide-ranging audiological rehabilitation, tinnitus management strategies, and specific vestibular rehabilitation methodologies to support patients.

This professional responsibility domain evaluates complex professional practice models, regulatory compliance frameworks, and ethical responsibilities across a wide variety of clinical, healthcare, and educational service delivery settings for audiologists.
study_focus: Professional Practice and Service Delivery Models

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the Prometric testing center or designated testing location well in advance with proper, government-issued identification. You will receive time to familiarize yourself with the computer interface before your 120-minute testing session officially begins.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of exactly 120 selected-response questions distributed across five content domains, covering clinical topics such as foundations, prevention, assessment, intervention, and professional responsibilities.

The exact passing score varies by state and certifying agency. You should always check directly with ETS or your specific regional licensing board to confirm your local score requirements before registering.
The examination has a total duration of 120 minutes and is administered securely on a computer at authorized test centers located worldwide for all registered candidates.

faq.question_title: Where can I take the Praxis Audiology Examination?
faq.answer_text: You can take the test at any convenient test center within an international network that includes Prometric Testing Centers, select universities, and other approved professional testing locations worldwide.
